headline: Impeachment Day 17 Focuses on ₱500-Million OVP Confidential-Fund Cash Trail
seoTitle: Sara Duterte Impeachment Day 17: ₱500M OVP Funds | FMB News
seoDescription: Day 17 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial examined the ₱500 million OVP confidential-fund cash trail and testimony of former disbursing officer Gina Acosta.
deck: Former OVP disbursing officer Gina Acosta testified about four ₱125-million cash releases as prosecutors questioned the handling and documentation of confidential funds.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Day 17 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial centered on the Office of the Vice President's ₱500 million in confidential funds and testimony from former special disbursing officer Gina Acosta.

Acosta testified that four ₱125-million cash tranches were released to Col. Raymund Dante Lachica from late 2022 through 2023. House prosecutors argued that the transfer to an officer who was not fidelity-bonded raised questions about accountability and compliance with government rules.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Acosta, called as a hostile prosecution witness, said she remained the accountable officer and described Lachica as the security officer tasked with implementing confidential operations. She also confirmed that names appearing on acknowledgment receipts were aliases and that she could not personally verify the identities of the ultimate recipients.

The defense has challenged the prosecution's interpretation of the records and has emphasized the liquidation documents submitted to government auditors. The proceedings concern allegations under Article I of the impeachment case; the testimony and prosecution arguments are not themselves a final finding of liability against the Vice President.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The testimony goes to the central question of how confidential public funds were handled, documented and ultimately accounted for. It also tests the evidentiary weight of liquidation records when the identities of operational recipients are concealed for confidentiality reasons.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The House prosecution said OVP Assistant Chief of Staff Lemuel Ortonio is expected next, followed by military officers subpoenaed in connection with Department of Education confidential funds. Watch for further testimony on the chain of custody, documentation and actual recipients of the funds.
